title: Electoral Democracy Code consultation plan
proposal: Pre-draft electoral consolidation covering election administration, political finance, voter-roll safeguards and party governance.

schedule.consultation_start: After public pre-draft package is published
schedule.consultation_end: Not fewer than 90 days after publication
schedule.urgent_exception: No urgency exception for electoral-system redesign; material change triggers re-consultation.

participation.anti_retaliation: Protected route for retaliation concerns; no disclosure of identity without lawful necessity and independent review.

integrity.lobbying_disclosure: Publish material meetings, funding and conflicts.
integrity.anti_capture: Publish moderation rules; detect duplicates and coordinated manipulation without excluding dissent; use representative outreach.
integrity.privacy: Minimise and redact personal data; publish reasoned summaries where needed.

deliberation.method: Public hearings and representative citizen panels

remedies.complaint_route: Accessible independent complaint route and judicial/legislative review
remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Material accessibility, manipulation, evidence, or draft-scope change
